items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: But I'd go there and play with them.

ctx.x: You see? Well, quite nice. They were men and I was boy. But I'd go there and play with them. You see, because they all knowed me. Was that done fairly often in those days? I mean... Yes, very often.
and wide and wide and wide.
